name: To The Noblest End
source:
Somewhere far away, a campaign of war begins.

Three disillusioned soldiers from varying backgrounds cross paths by chance. Drawn together by their differences, they trade fables of who they are, and who others think they should be.

Raf, a quiet and level headed Raven field medic - Ulfor, a strong Wolf warrior filled with stories - and Ælla, a young Golden Eagle warrant officer with a lot to prove.

The war may have brought them together, but will they find comfort amongst each other, or fade away into the tales they tell.

[From [url=https://deepbluefeeling.itch.io/to-the-noblest-end]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在遥远的某个地方，一场战争开始了。

三个来自不同背景、幻想破灭的士兵偶然相遇。他们因差异而聚集在一起，交换关于自己是谁以及其他人认为他们应该成为谁的寓言。

拉夫，一位安静、头脑冷静的乌鸦战地军医；乌尔福，一位充满故事的强大狼战士；埃拉，一位年轻的金鹰准尉，有很多事情需要证明。

战争可能让他们走到了一起，但他们会在彼此之间找到安慰，还是会消失在他们讲述的故事中。

[来自[url=https://deepbluefeeling.itch.io/to-the-noblest-end]Itch.io[/url]]
